1.heading: ye:

and God's mercies having been set before the people, one of them is introduced in a beautiful manner, asking what his duty is towards so gracious a God, Mic 6:6-7 ,. The answer follows in the words of the prophet, Mic 6:8 .

The answer follows in the words of the prophet, Mic 6:8 .
